notes: Real pre-trained U-Net+ResNet34 from Governor6191/sar-flood-extent-unet-resnet34. Conformal calibration run on Sen1Floods11 feature data (55 chips, 5 SAR-derived features -> water_fraction target). Coverage 0.9412 at alpha=0.1 (90% nominal), within [0.85, 0.95] target. Calibration uses LinearRegression on extracted features wrapped with MAPIE SplitConformalRegressor, not the ONNX model directly.

Real pre-trained U-Net+ResNet50 (SCSE attention) from vivek20072000/xview2-checkpoints on HuggingFace. Trained on xBD (xView2). Checkpoint best_f1=0.34 (epoch 182). xView2 baseline published F1=0.2654 (Gupta et al. 2019). Adapted: conv1 expanded 3->4 bands (B8 NIR from channel mean), seg_head adapted 5->4 classes (background dropped), seg_head input truncated 32->16 (smp version mismatch). Real pre-trained model. No calibration dataset available — model is validated but not calibrated.

Real pre-trained BERT (bert-base-uncased fine-tune) from sakibalfahim/CrisisPulse. Binary classification: 0=Not Disaster, 1=Disaster. Apache-2.0 license. Model card lists f1/accuracy/recall as tracked metrics but does not publish specific values. Exported with token_type_ids=zeros (single-sentence); ONNX graph exposes only input_ids and attention_mask per serving contract. Real pre-trained model. No calibration dataset available — model is validated but not calibrated.
